item.title: Vest with bees
item.description:
I was recently told (again) that I should share more widely the things I create, so here I am.

I made a vest, and I am reasonably proud of it. There were some trials, errors and turbulences, and there’s some small (really small) imprefections I will fix for the next one. But considering it’s my first actual attempt based on a self-drafted pattern, I am happy with it.
